summary: editable-contracts preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), extracts the bun binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a shipped 727KB file math_init.js. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated Bun-format bundle (string-array rotation, hex-obfuscated identifiers, char-code decoding) that is not referenced by the library's own source, not documented in the README, and does not exist in the upstream ServiceTitan editable-contracts project the package claims to mirror. The legitimate library code (dist/editable-contracts.js, src/) is shipped alongside as camouflage; the preinstall dropper and obfuscated payload are the added components. On npm install, arbitrary attacker-controlled code from math_init.js runs on the installer's machine under a freshly-downloaded second language runtime, evading Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
